title: The Barbie Diaries: High School Mystery

metadata.required_game_version: Retail PC v1.0 (2006-09-21 Build) — optional 32-bit Flash Player 8-10 ActiveX for SWF v8 intro/minigames
metadata.notes: Verified against the 2006 PC Retail/CD RenderWare Studio 2.0 release (`bin/game.exe` SHA-256 9da8b499...c0eb26). Fixes 0xc0000005 crashes in ConversationMgr::clearAll (RVA 0x00100806) and RwFreeListFree (RVA 0x000C1BA8), missing/outdated Flash ActiveX NULL dereferences, fullscreen D3D9 issues, shadow/light tuning, and broken shortcut working directory.

known_issues.summary: Access violation (0xc0000005 @ RVA 0x00100806) in ConversationMgr::clearAll during teardown or failed boot
known_issues.details: CRT static initialization constructs g_ConversationMgr after WorldMgr, so atexit teardown destroys ConversationMgr (freeing its sentinel node at offset +0x10) before WorldMgr calls clearAll(), dereferencing NULL [ecx] (`mov eax, [ecx]`). The binary bsdiff patch guards ecx, esi, and edi against NULL before dereferencing.

known_issues.summary: Access violation (0xc0000005 @ RVA 0x000C1BA8) in RwFreeListFree when freeing a NULL freelist
known_issues.details: During scene cleanup or shutdown, callers occasionally pass a NULL RwFreeList* pointer into RwFreeListFree (`mov esi, [edi+10h]`). The bsdiff binary patch checks `edi != NULL` at entry (`RVA 0x000C1BA4`) and returns NULL cleanly instead of crashing.

known_issues.summary: Crash or blank intro/minigames when ShockwaveFlash ActiveX (Flash.ocx) is missing or older than v8
known_issues.details: CAxFlashWindow embeds CLSID {D27CDB6E-AE6D-11CF-96B8-444553540000} for BumperScreen.swf (SWF v8), OpeningCinematic.swf (SWF v8), LoadingScreen.swf (SWF v7), and minigames (SWF v6/v7). Without a modern x86 Flash ActiveX control, IShockwaveFlash* is NULL, causing NULL pointer dereferences in PutMovie (0x00608EEF), GetVariable (0x00609090), FlashDialog::LoadMovie (0x006113CB), and FlashDialog::Close (0x00611E5E).
known_issues.user_action_required: OpeningCinematic.swf and BumperScreen.swf use SWF v8 (On2 VP6 video) and minigames use SWF v7. If Flash Player 6.0 (or no Flash ActiveX) is installed, movies and minigames remain blank: install 32-bit x86 Flash Player 8, 9, or 10 ActiveX (or EOL-free CleanFlash ActiveX x86) for intro playback, or rely on the enabled Flash bypasses.

known_issues.summary: Black screen, D3D9 mode-switch crashes, and 20 Hz shadow stutter on modern monitors
known_issues.details: Legacy exclusive D3D9 fullscreen fails mode switches or hangs during dialogs on modern Windows 10/11 displays, while MaxShadowUpdateFrequency=20 and zero-intensity lights add unnecessary CPU/GPU overhead. Enforcing windowed rendering (1024x768) via eesettings overrides, 60 Hz shadows, HKCU AppCompat shims, and 2-core affinity stabilizes frame pacing.

known_issues.summary: Launching game.exe directly defaults `-title` to `RatRace` instead of `Barbie` and fails without `-title Barbie`
known_issues.details: Without `-title Barbie -EnableFullScreen false -xsize 1024 -ysize 768` executed from `bin/`, the RenderWare Studio engine attempts to load `bin/RatRace` assets instead of `../Barbie` and fails during startup. OGSC passes the exact required working directory and arguments at launch.

fixes.title: Binary Crash Guards (0xc0000005 & Missing Flash COM Guards)
fixes.description: Applies a SHA-256-verified bsdiff patch to `bin/game.exe` adding six surgical x86 NULL-pointer guards: `ConversationMgr::clearAll` (RVA 0x00100806), `RwFreeListFree` (RVA 0x000C1BA8), `IShockwaveFlash::PutMovie` (RVA 0x00208EEF), `IShockwaveFlash::GetVariable` (RVA 0x00209090), `FlashDialog::Close` (RVA 0x00211E5E), and `FlashDialog::LoadMovie` (RVA 0x002113CB).

steps.name: Patch bin/game.exe NULL-Pointer Crash Guards
steps.description: Verifies vanilla `bin/game.exe` hash and applies verified bsdiff patch adding six NULL guards (reversible via `.ogsc_backup`).

fixes.title: Engine Performance & Flash Bypass (`eesettings.override.xml`)
fixes.description: Updates `Barbie/game/eesettings.override.xml` via verified bsdiff to enforce crash-free windowed mode, skip Flash bumper screens (`ToSkipFlashBumperScreen`), allow skipping minigames cleanly (`ToEnableFlashGameSkipping`), raise shadow updates from 20 Hz to 60 Hz (`MaxShadowUpdateFrequency=60`), prune zero-intensity lights, and silence script assertion popups.

steps.name: Optimize Engine & Flash Overrides XML
steps.description: Applies SHA-256-verified bsdiff overrides cleanly to `Barbie/game/eesettings.override.xml` without touching base `EeSettings.xml`.

fixes.title: Windows 10/11 Compatibility Shims & 2-Core Affinity
fixes.description: Applies non-destructive HKCU AppCompatFlags (`HIGHDPIAWARE`, `DISABLEDXMAXIMIZEDWINDOWEDMODE`) to `bin/game.exe` and constrains CPU affinity to 2 logical cores at AboveNormal priority on launch with the required `-title Barbie` arguments.

steps.name: Apply High-DPI & Presentation Compatibility Flags
steps.description: Sets per-user HKCU AppCompatFlags on `bin/game.exe` to prevent DWM fullscreen presentation freezes and DPI blur without triggering Windows XP UAC elevation.

steps.name: Limit CPU Affinity to 2 Logical Cores
steps.description: Pins `bin/game.exe` to 2 cores with AboveNormal scheduling priority on launch to keep RenderWare timing smooth on high-core CPUs.

fixes.title: dgVoodoo 2 Direct3D 9 -> Direct3D 11 Wrapper (Optional)
fixes.description: Deploys dgVoodoo 2 x86 `d3d9.dll` + `dgVoodoo.conf` into `bin/` with clean aspect-preserved scaling and 16x anisotropic filtering. Enable if your GPU driver flickers or drops textures.

steps.name: Deploy dgVoodoo 2 D3D9 Wrapper into bin/
steps.description: Translates legacy Direct3D 9 calls cleanly to Direct3D 11 for modern Intel/AMD/NVIDIA drivers.
